title: Idle beat: the GM advances the scene with atmosphere, not a combat or a scene jump

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I examine the carvings on the sarcophagus lid.

actions.text: The carvings tell a burial rite in worn relief: a knight, an oath, and a sword broken across a knee.
The silence stretches. Far off, water drips a slow count, and the torch flame bends toward the northern archway — as if something there breathes.
